openings.claim: Repair unreliable storage addresses using movement-linked slip updates and reservation-identity checks; shelving cart arrivals need not accelerate pickup.
openings.discriminator: Fewer second searches supports address repair; household mismatches or persistent peak waiting challenge sufficiency.
openings.probe: Compare location accuracy, second searches and pickup times with updates, matching volume, book size and desk load.
openings.uncertainty: Identity access, sustained upkeep and cart comparability remain unconfirmed.

openings.claim: Peak queueing may dominate the two-minute barrier.
openings.discriminator: Late accurate pickups dominated by waiting support queueing; search-dominated delays outside peaks challenge it.
openings.probe: Record arrival, retrieval start and handoff without changing priority.
openings.uncertainty: Counts establish no waiting durations; timestamps may delay service.

openings.claim: Freeze prepared positions, repair the slip before opening and retain arrivals on the cart to remove movement upkeep.
openings.discriminator: Reduced stale searches and upkeep support freezing; overflow, inaccessibility or unchanged searches defeat it.
openings.probe: Check capacity and preparation before adopting; compare a bounded evening at matched volume/size.
openings.uncertainty: Stationary retrieval, cart capacity and speed are unproven.

openings.claim: Establish whether existing private records uniquely match household discrepancies to reserving readers.
openings.discriminator: Any unsupported match defeats assumed verification availability.
openings.probe: Privately sample resolved/unresolved matches without changing handoffs.
openings.uncertainty: Record adequacy and population reliability remain unknown.

lineage.reason: Retains address, identity, cart counterexample and peak rival.
Retains movement repair and household rival.

decision: Check identity feasibility and waiting first, then compare locator repair/freezing. Only existing clerk performs handoffs; names/contact details stay behind desk; use existing two shelves/cart, no furniture. Shared daily preparation, including preparatory corrections, must fit ten clerk-minutes; track upkeep and stop infeasible probes. Verify recipients; measure 95% within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs. All evidence is synthetic; no improvement established.
